outlook.statement: We remain determined to capitalize on emerging opportunities while staying resilient amidst evolving market dynamics. Together, I am confident that we will continue to grow, create value, and achieve new milestones in the years ahead.

The inclusion of this subsidiary is expected to complement and strengthen the business operations of Shashwat Furnishing Solutions Limited. The performance of the subsidiary company has been satisfactory and is expected to contribute positively to the growth of the Company in the coming years.

The proposed transfer is intended to enable the Company to rationalize its investments, unlock value from its investment in the Subsidiary, improve liquidity and focus its financial and managerial resources on its core business activities and future growth opportunities.
The long-term outlook for the global manufacturing sector remains positive, supported by infrastructure investments, urbanization, increasing consumer spending and technological innovation.
The long-term outlook remains positive due to favourable demographic trends and increasing urbanization.
Growing global preference for sustainable and handcrafted products presents significant long-term opportunities for Indian manufacturers.

The Company intends to expand its geographical presence across India and strengthen its footprint in international markets by developing long-term customer relationships and exploring new export destinations.
Continuous investment in design innovation and product development will enable the Company to respond effectively to changing customer preferences and emerging market trends.
The Company plans to improve operational efficiency through technology adoption, process automation, improved production planning and better capacity utilization.
The Company aims to leverage digital technologies for marketing, customer engagement, order management and business analytics to improve decision-making and customer experience.
Focused branding initiatives, participation in trade exhibitions and enhanced digital presence will support wider market recognition and customer acquisition.
The Company remains committed to adopting environmentally responsible manufacturing practices, efficient resource utilization and sustainable sourcing to create long-term value for stakeholders.
